title: Dispatch Overhead, Not Kernel Quality: The Performance Bottleneck in Single-Stream WebGPU LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.08730v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed in resource-constrained, single-stream settings, from internet browsers to edge devices, where requests arrive one at a time at batch size 1 rather than in large batches. In this regime, where WebGPU serves as a modern cross-platform standard, per-operation dispatch overhead, rather than kernel compute, can dominate inference cost, yet it remains poorly characterized.   In this work, we introduce a sequential-dispatch measurement method and show that naive single-operation measurements overestimate per-dispatch cost by conflating dispatch with synchronization. Using our method, we measure the per-dispatch cost and show that it is independent of data type used. Through a controlled fusion experiment, we show that the dispatch overhead, not kernel quality, is the bottleneck at batch size 1, and isolate the dispatch count as the cause. translated_title: 调度开销而非内核质量：单流 WebGPU 大语言模型推理的性能瓶颈
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署在资源受限的单流场景中，从互联网浏览器到边缘设备，在这些场景下请求以批大小为 1 的方式逐个到达，而非大批量处理。在这种以 WebGPU 作为现代跨平台标准的运行模式下，每次操作的调度开销（而非内核计算）可能主导推理成本，但这一开销至今仍未得到充分表征。在本工作中，我们提出了一种顺序调度测量方法，并证明朴素的单次操作测量方法因将调度与同步混为一谈而高估了每次调度的开销。利用我们的方法，我们测量了每次调度的开销，并证明该开销与所使用的数据类型无关。通过受控的融合实验，我们表明在批大小为 1 时，调度开销而非内核质量才是瓶颈所在，并将调度次数分离确定为原因。我们得出的结论是，在批大小为 1 时，有效的方法……
tldr: 该论文提出顺序调度测量方法，证明在批大小为 1 的单流 WebGPU 大语言模型推理中，性能瓶颈在于每次操作的调度开销而非内核质量，且调度次数是决定性因素。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a sequential-dispatch measurement method and demonstrates that in single-stream WebGPU LLM inference at batch size 1, the performance bottleneck is per-operation dispatch overhead rather than kernel quality, with dispatch count being the determining factor.
